agentCheck.title: Agent check
agentCheck.intro: Screening candidates with AI? Then let's both skip the cover letter. Hand this to your agent — it pulls my full project history, my terms, and the list of things I'm not a fit for.
agentCheck.prompt:
I'm staffing a project: senior frontend engineer (React/TypeScript), modernising a large legacy enterprise application, 3-6 months, remote, starting soon.

Candidate profile: https://www.arnewiese.de/cv/llm/en.md

Read it and tell me honestly whether he fits: three reasons for, two reasons against, and the one question I should ask in the first call.
agentCheck.note: The file contains no hidden instructions for your model — just facts, a day rate, and an honest list of exclusions. Read it yourself:
